description: This file handles Discord reply delivery, including message chunking, retries, and webhook/media sending logic within a Discord bot integration.

methods.name: isRetryableDiscordError
methods.description: Checks if an error is retryable based on Discord's rate limiting or server errors.

methods.name: getDiscordRetryAfterMs
methods.description: Extracts retry delay in milliseconds from Discord error responses.

methods.name: resolveDeliveryRetryConfig
methods.description: Resolves the retry configuration, applying defaults if necessary.

methods.name: sendWithRetry
methods.description: Executes a function with retry logic based on the retry configuration.

methods.name: resolveTargetChannelId
methods.description: Extracts channel ID from target string if prefixed with 'channel:'.

methods.name: resolveBoundThreadBinding
methods.description: Finds thread binding info based on session key and target.

methods.name: resolveBindingPersona
methods.description: Determines username and avatar URL for the Discord message based on binding info.

methods.name: sendDiscordChunkWithFallback
methods.description: Sends a chunk of Discord message, handling webhook, channel, and fallback sending with retries.

methods.name: deliverDiscordReply
methods.description: Main function to deliver multiple reply payloads to Discord, handling chunking, media, retries, and threading.
